Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. code is one of: 401 unauthenticated; 403 access_denied; 404 not_found; 409 conflict; 422 validation_error; 422 user_error; 422 invalid_request; 500 internal_error. See /docs/api/errors for what each means.

Context.description: Context for the call, such as lang, tz and allowed_company_ids.

instance.description: An opaque id for this occurrence; present on 5xx only.

type.description: A reference to the error code's entry on /docs/api/errors.

Ids.description: Record ids the method is called on.

allow_cash_on_delivery.description: Allow customers to choose Cash on Delivery as their payment method.
allow_cash_on_delivery.title: Cash on Delivery

amount.description: Amount of the order to benefit from a free shipping, expressed in the company currency
amount.title: Amount

carrier_description.description: A description of the delivery method that you want to communicate to your customers on the Sales Order and sales confirmation email.E.g. instructions for customers to follow.
carrier_description.title: Carrier Description

debug_logging.description: Log requests in order to ease debugging
debug_logging.title: Debug logging

excluded_tag_ids.description: The method is NOT available if at least one product of the order has one of these tags.
excluded_tag_ids.title: Excluded Tags

fixed_margin.description: This fixed amount will be added to the shipping price.
fixed_margin.title: Fixed Margin

free_over.description: If the order total amount (shipping excluded) is above or equal to this value, the customer benefits from a free shipping
free_over.title: Free if order amount is above

get_return_label_from_portal.description: The return label can be downloaded by the customer from the customer portal.
get_return_label_from_portal.title: Return Label Accessible from Customer Portal

invoice_policy.description:
Estimated Cost: the customer will be invoiced the estimated cost of the shipping.
Real Cost: the customer will be invoiced the real cost of the shipping, the cost of theshipping will be updated on the SO after the delivery.
invoice_policy.title: Invoicing Policy

margin.description: This percentage will be added to the shipping price.
margin.title: Margin

max_volume.description: If the total volume of the order is over this volume, the method won't be available.
max_volume.title: Max Volume

max_weight.description: If the total weight of the order is over this weight, the method won't be available.
max_weight.title: Max Weight

must_have_tag_ids.description: The method is available only if at least one product of the order has one of these tags.
must_have_tag_ids.title: Must Have Tags

prod_environment.description: Set to True if your credentials are certified for production.
prod_environment.title: Environment

return_label_on_delivery.description: The return label is automatically generated at the delivery.
return_label_on_delivery.title: Generate Return Label

shipping_insurance.description: Shipping insurance is a service which may reimburse senders whose parcels are lost, stolen, and/or damaged in transit.
shipping_insurance.title: Insurance Percentage

tracking_url.description: This option adds a link for the customer in the portal to track their package easily. Use <shipmenttrackingnumber> as a placeholder in your URL.
tracking_url.title: Tracking Link

website_absolute_url.description: The full absolute URL to access the document through the website.
website_absolute_url.title: Website Absolute URL

website_description.description: A description of the Product that you want to communicate to your customers. This description will be copied to every Sales Order, Delivery Order and Customer Invoice/Credit Note
website_description.title: Description for Online Quotations

website_url.description: The full relative URL to access the document through the website.
website_url.title: Website URL

zip_prefix_ids.description: Prefixes of zip codes that this carrier applies to. Note that regular expressions can be used to support countries with varying zip code lengths, i.e. '$' can be added to end of prefix to match the exact zip (e.g. '100$' will only match '100' and not '1000')
zip_prefix_ids.title: Zip Prefixes

lang_id.description: Select the language to translate product names, descriptions, and other text in the feed.
lang_id.title: Language

message_has_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.title: Message Delivery error

message_has_error_counter.description: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.title: Number of errors

message_has_sms_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.title: SMS Delivery error

message_needaction.description: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.title: Action Needed

pricelist_id.description:
Specify a pricelist to localize the feed with a specific currency. If not set, the default website pricelist will be used.
Note that the pricelist must be selectable on the website.
pricelist_id.title: Pricelist

video_url.description: URL of a video for showcasing your product.
video_url.title: Video URL

align_category_content.description: Align the category content on the shop page. Corresponds to the 'Center Content' editor option.
align_category_content.title: Align Category Content

cover_image.description: Displayed only in the Category List Snippet.
cover_image.title: Cover Image

show_category_description.description: Display the category description on the shop page. Corresponds to the 'Show Description' editor option.
show_category_description.title: Show Category Description

show_category_title.description: Display the category title on the shop page. Corresponds to the 'Show Title' editor option.
show_category_title.title: Show Category Title

assign.description:
Defines how this ribbon is assigned to products:
- Manually: You assign the ribbon manually to products.
- Sale: Applied when the product is visibly on sale.
- New: Applied based on the New period you will define.
- Out Of Stock: Applied when the product is out of stock.
assign.title: Assign

style.description:
Defines the display style:
- Ribbon: Shows a ribbon banner on the product image.
- Badge: Shows a small badge label on the product image.
style.title: Style

name.description: Define a custom unit to display in the price per unit of measure field.
name.title: Name
